title: Assemble shots, narration, captions and music into render.mp4
description:
## Background
Nothing yet turns the pieces into a video.

## Task
ffmpeg-based assembler: hold each shot for its narration span, cuts or crossfades, optional push-in on stills, captions, music mix, project aspect ratio.

## Acceptance criteria
The example project renders; picture and sound in sync to within one frame at each cut.

## Tests
Automated render of the example project with stub media; sync check from timings.

## Reference
docs/planning/PLAN_FOR_AI_MOVIE.md, section 5.5.

title: Pipeline runner with approval checkpoints
description:
## Background
Each stage is a separate module. Nothing runs them in order, and the plan requires three human approval points: script, storyboard frames, final render.

## Task
Add `node bin/ai-movie.js run <project>` that runs each stage whose outputs are missing or older than their inputs, and stops at each approval point until the human marks it approved (for example an `approved` field in project.json per checkpoint).

## Acceptance criteria
- Running twice does no work the second time.
- Changing one shot's description reruns only that shot's storyboard, generation and the assembly.
- The run stops at each checkpoint until approved.

## Tests
End-to-end test on the example project with stub generation and TTS services.

## Reference
docs/planning/PLAN_FOR_AI_MOVIE.md, sections 2 and 4.

title: Enforce joint limits on reach-target limbs
description:
## Background
Limbs placed by `ik` targets bypass the joint-range check, so impossible elbows and knees can pass silently.

## Task
After solving a two-bone chain, compute the resulting shoulder or hip and elbow or knee angles in the parent frame and compare them with the limits table. Warn first; clamping would move the hand off its target.

## Acceptance criteria
- A target that needs a reversed elbow produces a warning.
- Existing reference scenes produce no new warnings, or each new one is reviewed and the scene fixed.

## Tests
Unit test with a deliberately impossible target.

## Reference
lib/pose/README.md, "Known limits".

title: Warn when limbs pass through the body, each other, or props
description:
## Background
Nothing detects interpenetration, so a pose can be legal in numbers and wrong on paper.

## Task
Approximate limb segments and torso parts as capsules, props as boxes and bars. Report overlapping pairs beyond a tolerance, excluding joints that are meant to touch.

## Acceptance criteria
Reference scenes that legitimately touch (hands on a rail, sitting on a box) do not warn; a forearm pushed through the chest does.

## Tests
Unit tests for both cases.

## Reference
docs/planning/PLAN_FOR_AI_MOVIE.md, section 5.2, item 5.

title: Refactor mannequin.js into readable modules with unchanged output
description:
## Background
mannequin.js grew by patching during review. Names are terse (P, BL, EX, GS) and state is global.

## Task
Split into math, shapes, skeleton, render and api modules under lib/pose/. Rename variables and replace globals with a per-render context. No behaviour change.

## Acceptance criteria
Golden tests pass byte for byte. The public API (renderFrame, renderSheet, renderLineup) is unchanged.

## Tests
Golden tests.

## Reference
docs/planning/PLAN_FOR_AI_MOVIE.md, section 7, last risk.

title: Add environment primitives: ground plane, rooms, cuboid buildings, doors, windows
description:
## Background
Frames show only figures and a few props. A storyboard frame needs a place.

## Task
New prop types: `room` (floor and walls with optional openings), `building` (cuboid with a window grid), `door`, `window`, and `ground` (horizon and ground grid), drawn in the same sketch style with depth sorting.

## Acceptance criteria
- Interior and street reference scenes added to resource/pose.
- Rendered and reviewed by the human.

## Tests
Golden renders for the new scenes; schema updated.

## Reference
docs/planning/PLAN_FOR_AI_MOVIE.md, section 5.2, item 3.

title: Add lighting and cast shadows
description:
## Background
Chui cares about light and shadow in room shots, and exteriors at dawn, evening and night with headlights, rain and puddles.

## Task
Scene-level light sources (sun direction, point lights, car headlights). Draw shadow shapes as toned fills projected onto ground and walls, plus simple reflections on wet ground.

## Acceptance criteria
Reference scenes for a room interior, dawn, evening, and a night street with headlights and puddles, reviewed by the human.

## Tests
Golden renders.

## Reference
docs/planning/PLAN_FOR_AI_MOVIE.md, section 5.2, item 4.

title: Support and test several figures in one frame
description:
## Background
Shots often have two or more people. The renderer was built around one figure.

## Task
Scene record gains `figures: [...]`, each with a profile and pose, keeping a single `pose` as shorthand. Depth-sort across figures.

## Acceptance criteria
Reference scenes: two people talking; one person handing a box to another.

## Tests
Golden renders; schema updated.

## Reference
docs/planning/PLAN_FOR_AI_MOVIE.md, section 5.2, item 6.

title: Convert a shot description into a scene record with an LLM
description:
## Background
Every scene record so far was written by hand. The pipeline needs this step to run from text.

## Task
Prompt plus code: given a shot description and the reference library, produce a scene record, validate it, render it, and feed warnings back for up to three correction rounds. Start from the closest reference pose rather than from nothing.

## Acceptance criteria
- For 10 varied shot descriptions, at least 8 produce valid records with no warnings within 3 rounds.
- The human reviews the renders; results noted on this bead.

## Tests
Validation and warning checks automated; visual judgement by the human.

## Reference
docs/planning/PLAN_FOR_AI_MOVIE.md, section 5.2 item 2, and section 7.

title: Write JSON Schemas for the scene record and shots.json
description:
## Background
Stages communicate only through files. The scene record is documented in prose only, and shots.json does not exist yet.

## Task
Add `schema/scene.schema.json` and `schema/shots.schema.json` (JSON Schema 2020-12). Cover every field in lib/pose/README.md, with joint arrays, enums for hand and prop types, and required fields.

## Acceptance criteria
- All 18 files in resource/pose validate.
- A record with an unknown pose key or a wrong-length joint array fails.

## Tests
Validation test over resource/pose, plus negative fixtures.

## Reference
docs/planning/PLAN_FOR_AI_MOVIE.md, section 4, "Data contracts".

title: Validate scene records in the pose CLI before rendering
description:
## Background
Bad records currently render something odd instead of failing.

## Task
Add a dependency-free validator and a `node lib/pose/cli.js validate <file|folder>` command. `render` validates first and exits non-zero with a readable message on failure.

## Acceptance criteria
- Invalid record: non-zero exit, and the message names the field.
- Valid records render as before (golden tests unchanged).

## Tests
CLI tests for valid and invalid input.

## Reference
docs/planning/PLAN_FOR_AI_MOVIE.md, section 4.

title: Define the project folder layout with an example project
description:

## Acceptance criteria
Example project validates against the schemas and its scenes render.

## Tests
Test that renders every scene in the example project.

title: Add golden-render regression tests for the reference poses
description:
## Background
lib/pose has no tests. Refactoring or new drawing features could silently change every frame.

## Task
Add `test/pose.golden.test.js` using `node --test`. For every `resource/pose/*.json`, render with seed 11 and compare the SVG text with a stored golden file under `test/golden/`. Regenerate goldens when `UPDATE_GOLDEN=1` is set.

## Acceptance criteria
- `node --test` passes on a clean checkout.
- Changing one number in a profile makes the test fail and names the affected scenes.
- Golden files are SVG text, committed.

## Tests
The test itself, plus a unit test that `renderFrame` is deterministic for a fixed seed.

## Reference
docs/planning/PLAN_FOR_AI_MOVIE.md, section 5.2, missing item 1.

title: Test the renderer warnings: clamped joints, unreachable targets, gaze shortfall
description:
## Background
The renderer reports clamped angles, unreachable reach targets and gaze shortfalls. Nothing checks that these work.

## Task
Unit tests with small hand-written scene records that trigger each warning, plus one that triggers none.

## Acceptance criteria
Each warning type has a test asserting its text pattern.

## Tests
As described.

## Reference
lib/pose/README.md, "Use".
